mapper.select: SELECT e.approval_id AS evaluator_id, p.employee_id, p.title, p.start_date, p.end_date, DATE(p.created_at) AS created_at, p.work_item, p.achievement_rate, p.work_detail FROM performance p INNER JOIN evaluation e ON e.employee_id = p.employee_id WHERE e.approval_id = #{employeeId} AND p.status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
